newsitem.title: DENMARK: SAS, Lufthansa, developing joint check-in system.
newsitem.headline: SAS, Lufthansa, developing joint check-in system.

text.p: Scandinavian Airlines System SAS and strategic partner Lufthansa of Germany are working on a joint computerised check-in system that the two carriers hope will cut processing costs.
Lufthansa staff magazine Lufthanseat said that the project, expected to end its development phaase within six months, could save 700,000 marks a year at Amsterdam's Schiphol aiport alone.
The magazine said a longer-term aim was to expand the system to all members of the Star Alliance, established last May.
The alliance groups SAS, Lufthansa, United, Air Canada, Thai Airways International and Brazil's Varig. -
